plate_findings.evidence: Erythematous chilblain-like nodules on the palmar site of the fourth digit

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Clinical photograph of a SAVI patient showing a chilblain-like acral nodule, a recognized SAVI cutaneous manifestation. B: Clinical photograph of a SAVI patient showing a chilblain lesion on the thumb, consistent with SAVI pernio-like acral lesions.

panels.figure_caption: Clinical findings in patient P2. A. Erythematous chilblain-like nodules on the palmar site of the fourth digit. B. Chilblain lesion on the left thumb
in_text_mentions: At 17 years of age, the mother of our index patient (P2) presented with reddish skin lesions on the dorsal side of her hands and feet which became increasingly painful nodules (Fig. 3A, B). A skin biopsy showed sparse dermal inflammatory infiltration resembling systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) or chilblain lupus. At 19 years of age, she started developing arthralgias of her hand and feet about three months after delivery with stiffness and swelling in her fingers and toes, especially the proximal interphalangeal joints. Her joint pain increased significantly limiting her daily activities. Im
